name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.5 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.5 restores Jellyfin's native right-click and multi-select administration by keeping context-menu handling untouched and raising the native selection command bar above Velvet Antenna navigation, while retaining inline IDENTIFY, duplicate resolution badges and DELETE, native Series/Season functionality, subtitles and detail PLAY/CONTINUE.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.9 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Collections-focused Antenna Flow release. v0.22.9 gives the Collections library its own API-backed BoxSet grid so every collection returned by Jellyfin is visible beneath the Velvet Lens instead of relying on Jellyfin's generic list page. Collection Manager artwork is upgraded from file-upload-first controls to PICK POSTER and PICK BACKDROP, opening a curated gallery from Jellyfin's configured remote image providers using getAvailableRemoteImages and applying the chosen image through downloadRemoteImage. Source-aware TMDb completeness through the optional Velvet Antenna Bridge, direct Add/Remove collection membership, v0.22.8 navigation reliability, permanent player EXIT, first-paint Home, Tonight, Velvet Lens, right-click administration and CC+ subtitle search remain included.
